start.description: Start date selected in the filter panel.

end.description: End date selected in the filter panel.

interval.description: The {@link Interval} selected for the plotting the values.

showAlerts.description: Plot alerts on the chart if the field is set to `true`.

showUnplannedEvents.description: Show unplanned events on the chart if the field is set to `true`.

showWorkOrders.description: Show work orders on the chart if the field is set to `true`.

showTrainingPeriod.description: Show training period on the chart if the field is set to `true`.

features.description:
Selected features to be plotted.

This field will carry the IDs of features selected in filter panel.

showFeatureContributionsToRiskScore.description: Show the feature contribution->risk score mapping on chart if field set to `true`.

showFeatureReconstruction.description: Show the feature reconstruction on chart if field set to `true`.

displaySensorTrainingBounds.description: Show the sensor training bounds on chart if field set to `true`.

sensors.description: List of selected sensors in the filter panel.

reliabilityMetricIds.description: List of {@link ReliabilityMetric} Ids to be selected.

alertId.description: The id of the {@link ReliabilityAssetAlert} being viewed.

showNonOperationalPeriods.description: If true, filter out non-operational periods from the charts using the #NON_OPERATIONAL_MASK_NAME.

title:
Spec for plotting the charts on the Residual Diagnostics Alert Detail page.

This spec will be populated using the values selected in the ResidualDiagnosticsAlertDetailFilterPanel
and sent to the charting API.
name: ResidualAlertFilterPanelSpec
